newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Orbital Sciences started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Orbital Sciences started.

text.p: -- Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc said Friday it initiated coverage of Orbital Sciences Corp with a buy-market outperformer rating.
-- Orbital stands to benefit from expected growth in demand for smaller satellites as it is one of the few manufacturers to specialize in that segment, Refsnes said.
-- Orbital has a full launch schedule set for 1997, after experiencing problems with its Pegasus launch vehicle dating back to 1995, Refsnes said.
-- Orbital's data and messaging services venture has the potential to be a "home run" for the company, Refsnes said.
